NOTICE - Extended Voting Hours for 3 Precincts
The Court of Common Pleas has granted a petition for a 30-minute extension of voting hours at three precincts due to machine set-up issues that briefly delayed the opening of those polling locations this morning. These precincts will remain open and accessible to voters until ; votes cast after  will utilize provisional ballots:
Precinct 201 (Easttown 3) - Easttown Township Library, 720 First Avenue, Berwyn
Precinct 210 (Easttown 6) - St. John's Presbyterian Church, 217 Berkley Road, Devon
Precinct 244 (East Goshen 2) - Goshen Baptist Church, 1451 West Chester Pike, West Chester
The ballot drop box at the Easttown Library & Information Center will close at . All other precincts in Chester County will close at  as scheduled.

NOTICE
On Tuesday, November 3rd at , The County Board of Elections will conduct the central count of ballots which will take place on the 5th floor, located at 313 W. Market St., West Chester, PA.
The Chester County Board of Elections will conduct rolling legal review as ballots are processed during the 24/7 central scan operation starting on November 3rd at  which potentially will continue the days thereafter, located on the 5th floor, located at 313 W. Market St., West Chester, PA.
The official computation of the votes cast & the provisional votes cast at the General Election held on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, in Chester County, as returned by the election officers of the precincts, will begin at  on Friday, November 6, 2026, on the 5th floor, located at 313 W. Market St., West Chester, PA.
